description:
Stage the kitchen of the Sample House with small appliances. 

Goal: Place at least two different small kitchen appliances (e.g., Coffee Maker, Toaster, Microwave, Blender) onto the countertops of the kitchen.

1. Open the 'Sample House' project if not already loaded.
2. Navigate to the Kitchen area.
3. Using the Interior > Furniture/Accessories library, find small kitchen appliances.
4. Place at least TWO DIFFERENT appliances (e.g., one toaster and one coffee maker) on the kitchen counters.
5. Ensure they are resting ON the counter surface, not on the floor or floating.
6. Save the project to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\DreamPlan\KitchenStaging.dpp'.
